about: The Workbench icons of the Triplane drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is the game's own application icon, the red triplane (data/application_icon/triplane.xpm, as a PNG). drawer.info is the Triplane drawer's own icon, installed as Triplane.info beside it.
